criteria_evaluation.why_unevaluated: the criterion names a decade-resolution target as its threshold, which is not an occupancy; it was written ill-posed and is not evaluated after the run. The mean occupancy and its spread are the card's values

deviations.note: exact reproduction; neither the plan nor the envelope declares a tolerance for this parameter, so anything other than exact is reported as a deviation for a person to read rather than measured against a figure this card invented

exact reproduction; neither the plan nor the envelope declares a tolerance for this parameter, so anything other than exact is reported as a deviation for a person to read rather than measured against a figure this card invented

exact reproduction; neither the plan nor the envelope declares a tolerance for this parameter, so anything other than exact is reported as a deviation for a person to read rather than measured against a figure this card invented

targets.note: one decade on each of the four observables, measured from the same trajectory: well_residence_time, interwell_transition_rate and interwell_barrier_height belong to the same question

estimation.note: the registered estimators, applied to each record's trajectory projected on the line joining the traps: cores around the two histogram peaks of the pooled record, radius the plan's fraction of their spacing, sticky milestoning at the frame interval; occupancy as time assigned to well 1; each ordered rate as transitions out of a well over the time assigned to it; residence as the mean completed dwell. Trap 1 is at negative x and +x points from trap 1 to trap 2; the separation the engine solved from the barrier is 2.145 um.

numbers.name: temperature
numbers.note: the room's reading, not established to be the sample's. In this model it is a coordinate -- the noise amplitude -- and citing the room records why this value was chosen

numbers.name: viscosity
numbers.note: pure water; asked over 292-294 K and the entry's validity covers it. The bench's in-situ diffusivity, near the coverslip, replaces the Stokes drag in the re-prediction

numbers.name: bead_diameter
numbers.note: the tracer in the bottle in use

numbers.name: trap_stiffness_1
numbers.note: 1 pN/um. Nothing in the store gives a trap stiffness; the experiment calibrates each trap after it is set. Chosen at the soft end, where the stiffness-matching tolerance is about five per cent at this width

numbers.name: trap_stiffness_2
numbers.note: EQUAL to trap 1, and that is the finding rather than a simplification: with wells hundreds of kT deep, any ratio of 0.5 or below leaves a barrier from the deeper well of tens to thousands of kT at every separation, so the person's 1-to-100 range holds no hops at all

numbers.name: trap_width_1
numbers.note: the Gaussian width of each well. Unknown; the store holds none. Near the bead radius is the microscope side's estimate, and the lower end of the map's 1-2.5 um

numbers.name: trap_width_2
numbers.note: equal to trap 1's

numbers.name: barrier_target
numbers.note: the barrier from the deeper well in units of k_B*T -- a ratio, so the operator can pass it through: kT has no fixed SI factor. Inside the 1-10 kT window. THE SEPARATION IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the barrier moves by about 0.55 kT per 10 nm here, so the separation that gives 4 kT has to be known to about a per cent, which an explore-mode number cannot state and a bench cannot dial. The engine solves the separation from this barrier and reports it in the run record, and the bench tunes its separation the same way -- by the histogram, not by a number

numbers.name: integration_timestep_point
numbers.note: at A1's ceiling, and a tenth of the frame so a frame never falls between steps

numbers.name: save_interval
numbers.note: 10 ms, the middle of the 1-50 ms a camera might frame at. Assumed

numbers.name: startup_discard_point
numbers.note: at A2's floor

numbers.name: record_length
numbers.note: ten minutes, the short end of the 10-60 min the experiment might record. Assumed; the spread over records at 10, 30 and 60 min is a separate study

numbers.name: walkers
numbers.note: independent single-bead records in one engine run, each as long as the bench record

numbers.name: milestone_core_fraction
numbers.note: the core radius around each histogram peak, as a fraction of the peak spacing. Near merging the minima sit far inside the trap centres (+-0.67 w against +-1.08 w at the stiff point), so cores on the trap centres would miss the wells; the experiment applies the same rule to its own histogram

numbers.name: hops_per_record_min
numbers.note: below this a record bounds the rate rather than measuring it (the observable's own note)

numbers.name: box_length_point
numbers.note: at A3's floor: a hundred widths, the far field flat and never wrapped

numbers.name: well_occupancy_mean
numbers.note: well 1's occupancy, the mean over 200 independent records of run-20260924-101-v2-full

numbers.name: well_occupancy_one_record_spread
numbers.note: the standard deviation over records: what ONE record's occupancy scatters by. 5th-95th percentile over records 0.23-0.81

numbers.name: transition_rate_1_to_2_mean
numbers.note: the registered rate out of well 1: transitions out over the time assigned to well 1, mean over records; one record's 5th-95th percentile 0.00411-0.0269 /s

numbers.name: transition_rate_1_to_2_one_record_spread
numbers.note: the standard deviation of that rate over records

numbers.name: transition_rate_2_to_1_mean
numbers.note: the same out of well 2; one record's 5th-95th percentile 0.00491-0.0338 /s

numbers.name: transition_rate_2_to_1_one_record_spread
numbers.note: the standard deviation of that rate over records

numbers.name: hops_per_hour_mean
numbers.note: all transitions, both directions, over the record, per hour: for planning a record, not the registered observable

numbers.name: residence_time_well_1_mean
numbers.note: the mean completed dwell in well 1 per record, averaged over records; the first and last dwell of each record are cut and not counted, so a short record understates long dwells. One record's 5th-95th percentile 25.3-192 s

numbers.name: residence_time_well_1_one_record_spread
numbers.note: the standard deviation of that per-record mean over records

numbers.name: barrier_projected_pooled
numbers.note: in units of k_B*T: -ln of the projected histogram pooled over all records, saddle minus the deeper peak. The potential's own barrier, computed, is 4.00

numbers.name: max_step_displacement
numbers.note: the largest single-step displacement, which the divergence criterion watches against the box

numbers.name: hops_per_record_median
numbers.note: the median over records of the transitions in one record

numbers.name: integration_timestep_actual
numbers.note: simulated time over the integer step count

numbers.name: save_interval_actual
numbers.note: simulated time over the intervals between saved frames

numbers.name: record_length_actual
numbers.note: simulated time after the startup discard

assumptions.statement: 1 pN/um for both traps: the soft end of what the tweezers hold a 5 um bead at, where the matching tolerance is about five per cent. Nothing measured picks it.
assumptions.falsifier: the experiment's calibrated stiffness of each trap, returned after the traps are set, replaces both and the simulation re-predicts at them

assumptions.statement: A Gaussian width of 1 um, near the bead radius. Unknown, and the map spans 1-2.5 um to show how much the answer depends on it.
assumptions.falsifier: the width read off the calibrated single-trap histogram's departure from a Gaussian, or off the separation at which the two wells merge

assumptions.statement: 4 kT, inside the 1-10 kT window where hops are frequent enough to count and rare enough to be hops.
assumptions.falsifier: a run returning under a handful of hops per record lowers it

assumptions.statement: The record as the bench might take it, and the ensemble that stands for it: ten minutes, the short end of what the bench may record; 10 ms between frames, the middle of the camera's likely range; two hundred independent records, enough to see the spread one record shows; and a smoke run of a tenth of the record, one minute, enough to time the engine.
assumptions.falsifier: the bench's actual record length and frame interval replace the first two, and the thousand-record spread study replaces the ensemble

assumptions.statement: Cores a fifth of the peak spacing around each histogram peak; the occupancy moved by under 0.001 between a tenth and three tenths in the engine validation.
assumptions.falsifier: a record whose rate moves by more than its scatter between 0.1 and 0.3 needs a stated choice rather than this default

assumptions.statement: Ten hops a record separates a measured rate from a bound.
assumptions.falsifier: a record with fewer is reported as a bound and the plan's barrier is lowered

kb_refs.claim: The laboratory's ambient temperature is 20 degrees Celsius, read off a thermometer by the operator. It is a reading and not a setpoint, and it is the room's rather than the sample's.
The particles in the bottle in use have a diameter of 5 micrometres, with a coefficient of variation no greater than 2 per cent, measured directly by the operator on 2026-09-19.
Dynamic viscosity of pure water near 293 K is of order one millipascal second, and it changes by roughly two percent per kelvin in that neighbourhood.
